blind.B1: No for an exercise question: all 35 gastrocnemius samples are sedentary male WT/mKO/mTG at 3 or 24 mo (S1.1.p1, FIG1). Exercise samples exist only in proteomic cohorts (S3.2, FIG4C/D, DA.p1). No sample carries the exercise factor.
blind.B2: Aging (24 vs 3 mo WT) and PGC-1a mKO/mTG vs WT; n=6 per group except mKO 3 mo n=5 (FIG1 legend).
blind.B3: No repeated sampling indicated; separate animals per group; packet A lists no pairing key.
blind.B5: S3.7.p1: 'Differential expression analysis of the count matrix was performed with EdgeR. FDR < 0.01 were considered significant.' No DEG count reported for RNA-seq; 860 PC-aligned genes; FIG1 legend FDR < 0.05.

checks.evidence: Paper S1.1.p1/FIG1: RNA-seq is 3/24 mo x WT/mKO/mTG, all sedentary; exercise data are proteomics (FIG4C/D, DA.p1 MassIVE). Packet A shows no exercise words in any column. Refusal at design is correct.
Six groups from column prefixes; sizes 6/6/5/6/6/6 match FIG1 legend (mKO 3 mo n=5). No contrasts run.
Packet A: no candidate keys; young and old are different animals (3 vs 24 mo), no repeated sampling indicated by paper.
S3.7.p1 does not state joint vs pairwise; no fit run.
Sex and tissue constant; none recorded or needed.
Only TPM deposited (column sums 1e6); paper used edgeR on counts; limma on log2(TPM+1) correctly flagged as method deviation.
S3.7.p1 FDR < 0.01 transcribed correctly; FIG1 FDR<0.05 noted.
HANDBACK claims no DEG counts; paper reports none (860 PC-aligned genes). No overclaim.
Claim 'no exercised animals' is established from full 35-sample sheet and paper; true. Exercise arms are proteomic cohorts outside this series.

human_items: Open policy: whether mTG vs WT (sedentary exercise-mimic, SI Fig S3H) should be offered as a labelled genetic-proxy analysis.
summary: 该系列的35个样本全部为安静状态的WT/mKO/mTG小鼠(3或24月龄),不含运动组;运动结果来自蛋白质组数据。拒绝分析的理由属实,阈值与方法偏差记录正确,未发现需要修改之处。
